sections.text: A Touch of That Sweet Magic♪

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 500. Success value 100. 4x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Activates Vital Strike (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% damage reflection for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies frenzy (nullifies debuffs, nullifies status ailments, permits piercing through damage reduction and damage reflection) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Overcast for 60 seconds ([Special] increases max HP by 100%; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; increases all elemental defense by 60; recovers 50 Cost. After the effect ends, Time Extend activates and extends the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to yourself by 60 seconds for one time only.).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 17000
Paralysis and Psychological Contamination Resistance Up by 50

[Flavors of Love] Celti or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
